c3.description: Each box in the pantry has a label code, computed the way labelmaker computes a label code for a postcode, with the box's id as the label's running number. Pantry.labelOf(int id) returns the label of the box with that id as an Optional<String>, empty when there is none; Pantry.findByLabel(String code) returns the box carrying that label as an Optional<Box>, empty when no box carries it (null included). Box and pantry's existing behaviour stay as they are, so PantrySpecTest keeps passing.
